insight: Xcode 26 templates enable SWIFT_UPCOMING_FEATURE_MEMBER_IMPORT_VISIBILITY. With it on, `import SwiftUI` alone is not enough for ObservableObject/@Published/Timer.publish — the class fails with "does not conform to protocol ObservableObject" at the USE site, with no error in the class itself. Fix: add an explicit `import Combine`.

Naming a design-token enum `Layout` collides with SwiftUI's own `Layout` protocol (iOS 16+). Errors read as "Type any Layout has no member spineX" and cascade into bogus "cannot find Palette in scope" noise across files. Use `Metrics` or similar.

INFOPLIST_KEY_UIBackgroundModes is silently ignored by GENERATE_INFOPLIST_FILE — xcodebuild -showBuildSettings reports it set, but it never reaches the built Info.plist. Xcode's capability editor writes a real file. Fix: add a physical Info.plist with only UIBackgroundModes and set INFOPLIST_FILE; GENERATE_INFOPLIST_FILE stays YES and merges the rest.
